messages.author: 4076f5688b45a1a5
messages.subject: Summary of the implemented priors
parts:
Good morning, 
I'm wrting to ask if maybe there is a function that sums up all the prior specifications (default and set by the user) of a fitted bru object. The implemented model is a spatio temporal pc.matern with autoregression dynamics and gaussian likelihodd. I looked in internet but I could not find one, but maybe I'm wrong. 
Thank you for the help,
Alessandro

messages.author: afb003e064114795
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Summary of the implemented priors
parts:
The bru objects are inla objects with some extra added information, so all methods that extract info from inla objects should work on bru objects.

There were a couple of bugs in the inla package until not long ago that meant it didn’t always detect inla objects correctly, but that has been fixed, so if it complains, upgrade inla and try again.

Finn
